observations: Predicted five. After nine items, first-row cat counter read eight against true five; stream explicitly contained five cats, three dogs and one eel.
Added row: cat estimates 8/5, minimum five; dog 8/4, minimum four against true three. Third row changed dog to 8/4/3, minimum three. Eel 1/4/6 retained minimum one.
Screenshot showed outlined queried bucket in each row, selected minimum and true-count comparison. Reveal returned to original cat collision, explained only overestimates and min(8,5)=5.

complexity.reason: Small arithmetic makes an unfamiliar approximate data structure approachable.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Hash collisions and minimum of upper estimates.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low: next/play, add/remove rows, three query choices.

whyCool: An extra row helps different animals differently, making the minimum rule feel necessary rather than arbitrary.
caveat: Fixed tiny stream and chosen hashes; 'usually close' is asserted without an error-probability experiment. Positive increments only; broader update models not tested.
effort: Browser prediction, two manual stream steps then play all, two/three-row comparisons, three queried keys, screenshot and reveal.
bucketReason: Useful contrasting collision cases and clear query visualization, with limited transfer.

depth.evidence: Dog remains four after second row; eel uses a different best row.
